verdicts.reason: A breaks the design: the flavour names are stacked in reverse order and pulled away from their descriptors, which are also reordered, so 'Bright & zesty' no longer lines up with Blood Orange. One huge can sits next to two tiny orphaned cans at the bottom, the CTA is pushed up into the top-right corner above the headline, and the right-hand text column is a cramped centred stack. B keeps the original structure, order and brand, but it is mostly a shrunk copy of the original. The can labels, descriptors and 'Free chilled delivery' line are tiny and hard to read, the three columns are spread too far apart with a lot of empty space at the sides, and the small CTA lacks punch.
